sources.title: campplus · Models
sources.snippet: CAMPPlus Speaker Encoder This directory contains a local copy of the CAMPPlus speaker verification model, originally released through ModelScope / 3D-Speaker. The model is used to extract speaker embeddings from speech, while the original model architecture, weights, authorship, and license remain attributed to the original authors.
